package.name: rosie_driver
package.description:
ROSie Neato D6 Pi-side ROS 2 driver node.
Reads wheel encoders and LIDAR directly from the Neato serial port and publishes /scan (LaserScan) and /odom (Odometry) with correct capture-time timestamps via DDS. Also bridges HA MQTT integration (battery, state, settings, commands) and manages the no-go guard GPIO injection.
